requirement.description: Logging and observability are automated. That is simply the state of the system today.
requirement.reading: That is simply the state of the system today.

narrator.name: Reliability Ruth
narrator.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.content: The logging pipeline for the forecast service runs fully automated. It captures every request and response from the model endpoints without any manual intervention. Observability metrics stream continuously to the central monitoring stack, and alerts fire automatically when latency or error rates drift outside the defined thresholds. No one has to check the health of the deployment by hand or gather performance data manually. The system records the state of the service in real time, and the data is available for review at any moment. All monitoring tasks are handled by the automated tooling in place, so the infrastructure just keeps running its checks while the team focuses on other work.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state and capabilities of the logging and monitoring pipeline without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
